gloss: reversal; inversion; to flip; to reverse

definitions.explanation: Turning something to its opposite state — flipping an image, reversing a direction, or inverting a position. Used for physical rotation as well as abstract reversals of situation or trend.

examples.japanese: {画像|がぞう}を{反転|はんてん}する。
{左右|さゆう}{反転|はんてん}で{写真|しゃしん}を{保存|ほぞん}した。
examples.english: I saved the photo with a horizontal flip.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}の{流|なが}れが{一気|いっき}に{反転|はんてん}した。
examples.english: The momentum of the game reversed all at once.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{左右|さゆう}{反転|はんてん} (horizontal flip / mirror image)
・{上下|じょうげ}{反転|はんてん} (vertical flip)
・{反転|はんてん}{攻勢|こうせい} (turning to the offensive)
・{白黒|しろくろ}{反転|はんてん} (black-and-white inversion)

USAGE NOTES:
Very common in digital image editing, photography, and design contexts. Also used in sports and news to describe a dramatic turnaround in circumstances. The homophone {斑点|はんてん} (spot, speckle) is a different word.
